title: [DEV-M] Widget is broken
body: The widget is frozen after the update, re-adding (after deleting) is not possible.

comments.body:
I confirm. My dev-l version widget disappeared and now, can't add widget from dev-m

Widget is available but will not install. Android 13 S21FE
![Screenshot_20230928_122813_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/c75c6d24-d8b8-4840-8f39-06901d1cf743)
it works in emulator. what android version?

If I install dev-L, I can install the widget. With dev-M, I cannot install it. No update to the phone between the 2 versions. If I go back to dev-L, widget is "installable"


![Screenshot_20230929_051258_Settings.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/e779d3b9-28ad-489e-ae7e-976c4ebc2ab8)

Samsung Z Flip 4, Android 13, One UI 5.1.1 (September 2023)
Same here: Fine with dev-l, buggy with dev-m
Logcat after installing (widget freezes):
```
08:39:24.024  I  addProviderLocked Provider is added Provider{ProviderId{user:0, app:10423, cmp:ComponentInfo{info.nightscout.androidaps/app.aaps.ui.widget.Widget}}} at 107
```

```
08:45:23.693  D  bindAppWidgetIdIfAllowed() appWidgetIds = 121, provider = ComponentInfo{info.nightscout.androidaps/app.aaps.ui.widget.Widget}
```
More info needed?
Thanks!
same here with Samsung Fold 4 , Android 13
hmmm it does work in emulator :(

According to a book I read recently, we might all be the products of a huge emulator... ;)

The widget is working with this version.

![Screenshot_20230926_181601_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/de7f843a-e88c-4149-aa52-7c13a95a78e8)

Something changed between that and last Dev.
I installed the latest Dev-M. On my Pixel 4a the Widget is working. I am also on Android 13.
Maybe it is Samsung's ONE UI 5.x related... Both of us with problems are on Samsung phones.
you may try to uninstall aaps

Uninstalling will loose too much data.

Tested again with dev-l and the widget installed

![Screenshot_20230930_104240_One UI Home.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/560504f1-7d86-43e2-87c3-fa34db910048)
I did a reinstall with this change https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/2850 and it fixed the Widget
For the record: This doesnt happen on my Pixel 6 Pro on commit 81548b7
I confirm too. Including Eric's PR 2850 on Dev solved the widget problem. When updating from dev-L to dev-M + PR2850, the widget disappears but can be put back in place.
